act: Indian Stamp Act, 1899 (as applicable to Delhi), Schedule I-A

source.ref: Indian Stamp Act, 1899, Sch. I-A Art. 34 (Delhi)
source.quoted_text: Sch I-A Art. 34 (both columns): 'INDEMNITY BOND' — 'The same duty as a security Bond (No. 57) for the same amount.' Chain: Art 34 → Art 57 → (≤Rs 1,000: Bond No.15 = 2%; else Rs 100 flat).

notes_for_reviewer: CONFIDENCE: MEDIUM-HIGH. Pure cross-ref, resolved within the snapshot: indemnity ≤ Rs 1,000 → 2% of amount_secured; above Rs 1,000 → Rs 100 flat. Practical effect: virtually every commercial indemnity bond in Delhi is Rs 100.
